evidence.snippet: Darryl: Well you should definitely come. The foreman always comes. Plus it's fun, you know cookies, smoked fish, alcohol, people acting stupid.

beats.summary: Jim suspects Dwight is trying to entrap him regarding his bonus and credit card details.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Dwight really wants my bonus. He's trying to entrap me.
Jim: So Dwight did take the bait. He used my credit card numbers to send a two hundred dollar bouquet of flowers, to my wife…from me.
